source: The vendors a model reference may read as. openrouter: the OpenRouter vendor slugs of pricing_keys.json and of the openrouter ids of litellm_catalogue.json, without the spellings that are not a vendor slug (azure_ai, a route; moonshot, folded into moonshotai; openrouter, OpenRouter's own routers; nova, the engine's own namespace). not_on_openrouter: publishers named or served by the catalogue that carry no slug in that data, each with the reason it is a vendor.

not_on_openrouter.01-ai: 01.AI, publisher of the Yi models served by Fireworks
not_on_openrouter.aisingapore: AI Singapore, publisher of SEA-LION; its Hugging Face organisation
not_on_openrouter.baichuan: Baichuan Intelligence, publisher of the Baichuan models served by Novita
not_on_openrouter.bigcode: the BigCode project, publisher of StarCoder
not_on_openrouter.bigscience: the BigScience workshop, publisher of mt0 on watsonx
not_on_openrouter.bsc-lt: Barcelona Supercomputing Center, publisher of ALIA and Salamandra; its Hugging Face organisation
not_on_openrouter.databricks: Databricks' own models (DBRX, MPT), served by Databricks
not_on_openrouter.featherless-ai: Featherless AI, publisher of the Qwerky models it serves
not_on_openrouter.gigachat: Sber's GigaChat, served only by its own API under that name
not_on_openrouter.hcompany: H Company, publisher of Holo; its Hugging Face organisation
not_on_openrouter.huggingfaceh4: the Hugging Face H4 team, publisher of Zephyr
not_on_openrouter.opengvlab: Shanghai AI Laboratory's OpenGVLab, publisher of InternVL
not_on_openrouter.paddlepaddle: Baidu's PaddlePaddle organisation, publisher of PaddleOCR-VL
not_on_openrouter.phind: Phind, publisher of its own CodeLlama fine-tunes
not_on_openrouter.sarvamai: Sarvam AI, publisher of Sarvam-M; its Hugging Face organisation
not_on_openrouter.sdaia: the Saudi Data and AI Authority, publisher of ALLaM
not_on_openrouter.skywork: Skywork AI, publisher of the Skywork models served by Novita
not_on_openrouter.swiss-ai: the Swiss AI Initiative, publisher of Apertus
not_on_openrouter.togethercomputer: Together AI's own Hugging Face organisation
not_on_openrouter.twelvelabs: TwelveLabs, publisher of Pegasus on Bedrock
not_on_openrouter.vercel: Vercel, publisher of the v0 models
